svg.title: Kikuchi Hojudo process evidence
svg.desc: A government feature reports senior-to-junior apprenticeship and recycled iron at Kikuchi Hojudo, but accessible records do not establish a model-level mould route or mark technique.
svg.text: Kikuchi Hojudo: reported practice, unassigned mould route
Reported in Government of Japan feature
• about 50% recycled iron at time of report
• dry-mould route for a particular kettle
• lost-wax route for a particular kettle
Regional rules describe possible routes; they do not choose one for every Kikuchi Hojudo object.
